    sandbox.add_joint(left_middle, left_upper1, (left_middle.position.x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    # Upper1 -> Upper2
    anchor_y = left_upper1.position.y + beam_height / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_upper1, left_upper2, (left_upper1.position.x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    # Upper2 -> Upper3
    anchor_y = left_upper2.position.y + beam_height / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_upper2, left_upper3, (left_upper2.position.x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect left middle to middle strip
    anchor_x = left_middle.position.x + beam_width / 2
    anchor_y = middle_beam.position.y
    sandbox.add_joint(left_middle, middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle strip to right strip
    anchor_x = middle_beam.position.x - beam_width / 2
    anchor_y = middle_beam.position.y
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_middle, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect right middle to right upper
    anchor_y = right_middle.position.y + beam_height / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_middle, right_upper, (right_middle.position.x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect left upper1 to right upper
    anchor_x = (left_upper1.position.x + right_upper.position.x) / 2
    anchor_y = left_upper1.position.y
    sandbox.add_joint(left_upper1, right_upper, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    return left_middle
